RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel is common in healthcare and laboratory sciences and does not inherently indicate bias. For a head of department position, selection committees routinely prioritize formal management credentials and broad leadership experience over higher academic degrees such as a PhD.

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of discrimination lacks factual grounding and will likely harm your professional reputation and career prospects within the institution. Instead, send a polite follow-up to HR requesting constructive feedback on how to strengthen your leadership profile for future opportunities. Demographic composition alone is not actionable evidence of bias.
